products.description: Farm-raised Atlantic salmon. FARMED VS WILD, THE CURRENT TRUTH: farmed salmon's pink is synthetic astaxanthin added to the feed — U.S. law requires 'color added' on the label. Its omega-6-to-omega-3 ratio runs about 14 times worse than wild (0.7 vs 0.05). And antibiotic use depends on where it's farmed: Chile has used ~500 times more antibiotics per tonne than Norway. The old '10x more PCBs' claim is outdated — feed changed, and current European data shows wild Atlantic salmon now carries MORE dioxins and mercury than farmed. We tell it as the data reads today. BAP certification and Norwegian-style practice are the better end of farming — but wild sockeye needs no color additive and carries the ancestral omega ratio on its own.
